title: Trace viewer interaction + wireframe notes (iterative)
content:
Purpose:
- Capture interaction design and lightweight wireframes for an integrated request tracing UI (trace list -> detail -> span waterfall) to support debugging of inference requests in Redwood Console.
- Focus on quick dev handoff: scope MVP behaviors, keyboard interactions, filters, and acceptance criteria for grooming.

User personas & UX goals:
- On-call SRE: find erroring traces quickly (error rate, tails), jump to logs and CPU/memory metrics. Needs fast filters and keyboard nav.
- Backend engineer / model platform: understand latency breakdown by span (queue -> model-inference -> serialization). Wants grouping and compare traces.
- Product reliability owner: surface regressions, save queries, schedule alerts.

Top-level pages / states (wireframe names):
1) Trace Index (list)
   - Columns: trace id, timestamp, duration, status (ok/error), route/model, backend region, user-tag (customer id), sample link
   - Left rail: saved filters & pinned views, quick time window selector (last 5m/1h/24h/custom)
   - Right side: mini waterfall preview on hover (tooltip)
   - Actions: multi-select traces -> bulk tag/annotate/export
   - Keyboard: j/k to move rows, o to open trace detail, / to focus filter, ? for shortcuts

2) Trace Detail (primary canvas)
   - Header: trace metadata (trace id, request id, timestamp, duration, status, model variant, deployment pool)
   - Top bar: buttons — back-to-list, save-view, open-logs, open-metrics, create-incident (prefill trace link)
   - Primary area split: left vertical timeline + span list; right details pane for selected span (metadata, logs, events)

3) Waterfall + Spans (centerpiece)
   - Waterfall view horizontally aligned to timestamp. Each span: bar length = duration, color by category (network / queue / model / serialization / cpu-bound).
   - Spans grouped by host/pool + service. Group toggle: expanded vs collapsed. Collapse heuristics: contiguous tiny spans (<3ms) collapsed into summary node.
   - Hover on span: show tooltip with start/latency/bindings + quick links (jump to logs, open child spans, copy span id).
   - Click span: open right-hand details panel with JSON metadata, events, attached logs, and trace-level tags.
   - Zoom & pan: mousewheel to zoom time scale, click-drag to pan; selection rectangle to zoom into region; double-click to fit all.

Filters and search (critical interactions):
- Filter model/service: typeahead dropdown supporting multi-select and fuzzy match.
- Latency slider: dual-handle histogram synced to waterfall (show distribution + tail markers: p50/p95/p99).
- Error toggle: show only traces with errors / warnings / anomalies.
- Route/endpoint: match by prefix and support wildcards.
- Tag filters: key:value pairs (e.g., customer_id:acme-co). Persisted saved-filters.
- Time-relative quick presets and custom absolute range.

Behaviors and edge cases:
- Live streaming mode: for "tail traces" view, new traces append to top and gentle highlight; auto-pause when user interacts with waterfall.
- Missing spans: render gray placeholder bars with "span missing - possible sampling or instrument gap" & link to sampling config.
- Very long traces (>60s): show compact mode where long idle spans are collapsed with visible expand affordance.
- Overlapping spans: visual stacking with slight vertical offset + connector lines for parent-child.

Accessibility and performance notes:
- Use high-contrast color palette; ensure colorblind-friendly palette and explicit patterns or icons for error/warning states.
- Virtualize span list rendering; waterfall may contain thousands of spans — only render visible window.
- Keyboard-first interactions for power users; provide ARIA labels for spans and controls.

Wireframe sketch notes (visual to dev):
- Sketch A (index): top nav, left rail, main table, right mini-preview. Note: collapsible left rail width 280px min.
- Sketch B (detail): header with metadata chips, then waterfall occupying 65% horizontal width, RH details 35% with tabs {Overview | Logs | Events | Raw}.
- Sketch C (compare): two synchronized waterfalls to compare two traces side-by-side. Sync by offset or align to request start.

Backlog / grooming items (concrete tickets & acceptance criteria)
- JIRA-ENG-1287: Implement trace list API + pagination (P0)
  - AC: list endpoint returns trace id, duration, status, tags; supports filters by time window, model, status; supports cursor pagination.
  - Estimate: 5d backend + 2d frontend
- JIRA-UX-056: Waterfall component (MVP) (P0)
  - AC: render spans with start/time/length; hover tooltip; click to open details panel; zoom & pan minimal.
  - Estimate: 3d prototyping + 4d implement
- JIRA-UX-057: Filters & saved queries (P1)
  - AC: model/service search, latency histogram binding, save / load / share.
  - Estimate: 4d frontend + 2d backend
- JIRA-ENG-1302: Logs deep link from span -> logs service with span_id context (P1)
  - AC: clicking 'open logs' on span should open logs console pre-filtered by trace/span id; maintain time-range sync.
  - Estimate: 3d
- JIRA-UX-062: Accessibility pass + keyboard shortcuts (P2)
  - AC: all primary controls reachable by keyboard, focus indicators, ARIA labels.
  - Estimate: 3d

Open questions / decisions needed:
- Sampling policy UX: do we surface a sampling toggle per-view or just link to global sampling settings? (ask SRE)
- Should we show token-level cost on spans that represent inference? (product question — might expose cost signals)
- Retention/aggregation: when time window > 7d do we aggregate spans? How to surface aggregated waterfall?
- Compare mode: align by start vs align by event (e.g., model-start); default behavior?

Notes to devs / handoff checklist:
- Provide a simple mock server with 3 sample traces: short (30ms), medium (450ms with queuing), and long (12s with chunked inference). Include missing-span case and multi-host case.
- Provide CSS tokens for color categories: network (#2B7AE4), queue (#F2C94C), model (#8E44AD), serial (#27AE60), error (#E74C3C). Add patterns for colorblind-safe variants.
- Attach storybook stories for Waterfall component with knobs for span density, grouping toggles, and zoom levels.
- Add metrics hooks: instrumentation should emit span-hover and span-open telemetry events.

Appendix: quick mock data shape (for frontend devs)
- Flat span list: [span_id, parent_span_id, start_ms, duration_ms, service, host, tags, status] — (send as JSON array).
- Trace metadata: {trace_id, request_id, timestamp_iso, duration_ms, model_variant, pool, tags}.

Unresolved / todo:
- UX validation session: schedule 1-hour session with 3 SREs + 2 backend engineers to test Sketch B interaction (target: next sprint planning).
- Make a small prototype of compare-mode and run a 30-minute usability test.
- Finalize keyboard shortcut map and publish in Console help center.

If you want, I can convert the wireframe notes into a clickable Figma spec (low-fi -> hi-fi) and generate a prioritized sprint backlog with story points.

---
Notes-to-self: sometimes shorthand in these docs; when moving to Confluence, separate developer API contract from UX acceptance criteria.
